categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of forged aluminum alloy wheels for automobiles. The main product categories include commercial vehicle wheels and passenger vehicle wheels, along with other products such as forged stranded wire discs and wheel accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in forging technology for aluminum alloy wheels, which offers advantages over traditional casting methods including energy efficiency, emission reduction, lighter weight, and higher strength. The company has accumulated rich experience in forging processes and possesses core technologies including mold design, high-speed precision machining, and surface stress relief techniques. The company also employs advanced surface treatment technologies including diamond turning, polishing, painting, and nano-material coating (Magshine).
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves both OEM (original equipment manufacturer) and aftermarket segments. OEM customers include major Chinese truck manufacturers (Howo, Dongfeng Liuqi, Shaanxi Heavy Truck, BYD, CRRC Times) and international EV manufacturers (Rivian, Lucid via distributors). Aftermarket customers include global wheel retailers and distributors (WheelPros, AmericanWheels, Jost, KalTire, S.M.Heights, Weds). The company's products are sold to commercial vehicle, passenger vehicle, and EV markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Taizhou, Zhejiang. It has established overseas operations through subsidiaries in Hong Kong (Xinmei, Yuanteng, Yixin) and Thailand (Allotek). The company exports to multiple countries including the United States, Europe, Australia, Canada, and Japan. As of 2024, domestic sales accounted for 63.45% of revenue and overseas sales for 36.55%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the automotive supply chain. It is a Tier-1 supplier to OEMs and also serves the aftermarket through distributors and retailers. The company sources raw materials (primarily aluminum ingots) from suppliers and manufactures finished wheels for direct sale to customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) advancing forging technology and automation; (2) developing lightweight wheel designs for new energy vehicles; (3) expanding into international markets, particularly through the Thailand facility; (4) enhancing surface treatment technologies; (5) improving production efficiency and cost control; (6) developing products for diverse market segments including commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, and EVs. R&D initiatives focus on automated production lines, precision forging techniques, and advanced surface treatments.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of forged aluminum alloy wheels. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers, which varies by customer type: for OEM customers upon system reconciliation and delivery confirmation; for aftermarket customers upon customer acceptance; for export customers upon shipment and receipt of bills of lading or customer confirmation depending on Incoterms. The company also generates minor revenue from waste aluminum sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the forged aluminum wheel market against both domestic and international competitors. Major domestic competitors include Wanfeng Aowei, Lizhong Group, and Jinfei Kaida (primarily casting-focused). International competitors include established European and North American manufacturers. The company positions itself as a leading domestic forged wheel manufacturer with technological advantages in forging processes, product quality, and lightweight design. It has successfully broken the monopoly of foreign brands in China's commercial vehicle forged wheel market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 1,028.43 million yuan, representing 6.95% growth from 2023 (961.61 million yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 50.13 million yuan in 2024, down 31.28% from 72.94 million yuan in 2023, primarily due to rising aluminum prices and increased operating expenses. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in April 2024, raising 307.2 million yuan in net proceeds. Total assets grew to 1,618.43 million yuan at year-end 2024 from 1,121.71 million yuan in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) Superior forging technology providing lighter weight, higher strength, and better durability compared to cast wheels; (2) Proven quality with IATF16949 certification and multiple international test certifications; (3) Diverse product portfolio with multiple surface treatment options (polishing, painting, Magshine nano-coating, PVD); (4) Established customer relationships with major OEMs and global aftermarket distributors; (5) Technological expertise in lightweight design supporting EV market growth; (6) Cost-competitive manufacturing with expanding production capacity. The company emphasizes innovation, quality, and customer service as core differentiators.
